name: Punjab
description: Deep, fertile Indo-Gangetic plains supporting wheat, rice, and vegetables.

name: Rajasthan
description: Arid desert and semi-arid sandy soils with low organic matter.

name: Gujarat
description: Clay-rich regur soils in central tracts and coastal alluvium near the Arabian Sea.

name: Maharashtra
description: Basalt-derived black cotton soils with strong moisture retention.

name: Karnataka
description: Red loamy uplands with mixed black soil pockets in northern districts.

name: Tamil Nadu
description: Red, lateritic, and coastal alluvial soils under tropical dry to wet climates.

name: West Bengal
description: Deltaic alluvial soils grading toward lateritic western uplands.

name: Assam
description: Brahmaputra valley alluvium with humid subtropical conditions.

name: Himachal Pradesh
description: Shallow mountain soils across Himalayan slopes and valleys.

name: Odisha
description: Lateritic uplands and coastal alluvial belts suited to rice and pulses.
